_help: Where each tool is installed. Use forward slashes (C:/ML/waft) or double backslashes (C:\ML\waft). Run  python process_clip.py --check  after changing anything.

defaults._help: depth_engine: vda (Video Depth Anything) or da3 (Depth Anything 3). vda_encoder: vits = Small (commercial OK), vitb / vitl = Base / Large (non-commercial). depth_white: far (far = white) or near (near = white). flow_engine: memfof or waft. memfof_model: tskh (real-world) or spring (fine detail). flow_format (MEMFOF only): both (16-bit PNG + 32-bit EXR), png16 (PNG only) or exr (EXR only).
